summary: Async scheduling stops both requests at max_tokens with total scheduled tokens 2x(prompt+max_tokens-1) for max_tokens 3 and 1 (second scenario oracle-scheduler-kv-stop-by-max-tokens-1); trace takes the async in-flight skip.

P2PSecondaryTierManager is not modeled (factory resolves p2p but stops); kv-cache-utils.get-none-hash-seed returns the right default, but no p2p manager reads it for the handshake (manager.py:689-693).

With ExampleConnector the schedule step uses kv-cache-manager.get-computed-blocks and no for-connector lookup (scheduler.py:558-568). The model lacks the divergent branch entirely, which the capable-connector sibling test would expose.
